Trajectory integrator: adaptive symmetric second-order step.
Pair: proton + electron (reduced mass 0.999456 m_e, Bohr radius 1.00054 a0, binding 13.5983 eV).
Starting separation: a_n = 1 a_pair (n = 1) = 52.9465 pm -- an initial condition for the classical inspiral, not a claimed energy eigenstate.
Interaction experiment: EACH particle's lab kinetic energy ~ N(0.6, 0.4) eV truncated at 0.012 eV, drawn independently, so the pair carries a net momentum and the centre of mass moves; K_CM below is the invariant derived from the two, and each trajectory is integrated in that COM frame.  (b_y,b_z) ~ N_2(0, sigma^2 I), hence b ~ Rayleigh(sigma = 500 pm), truncated by rejection at R_match/2; both dipoles isotropic.

  Ortho-Positronium      0.5%
This is a censoring-sensitivity estimate, not a replacement for the raw counts above.

Sampled beam parameters:
  all trajectories   <K_CM> = 0.704281 eV,  <b> = 637.357 pm
  Collision         <K_CM> = 0.664757 eV,  <b> = 17.5073 pm
  Scattering        <K_CM> = 0.706693 eV,  <b> = 643.495 pm
  Ortho-Positronium <K_CM> = 0.266267 eV,  <b> = 41.8922 pm

Quasi-closed orbit of the captured pairs (1 of 1 bound events):
  T  minimum 540.46 fs
  T  mean    540.46 fs
  T  maximum 540.46 fs
  revolutions observed: minimum 0.000370055, mean 0.000370055, maximum 0.000370055
T is the Kepler period of the osculating capture orbit, the longer of its capture-time and window-close values.
The revolution count is what the bound observation window actually covered, NOT a count to collapse: these pairs are
followed only long enough to classify them, so the window is bounded by boundObservationTimeCap.

No bound event yielded a finite collapse time: 1 of 1 had an observation window shorter than one Kepler orbit,
so no orbit-averaged power exists for them.  These captures are loose enough that one period exceeds the bound observation cap.
Bookkeeping identity residual (not a conservation test): median 2.57946e-05; independent |dE_LL-vs-flux|/E_rad median 1.00109.
Capture observables (audit 393): sigma_capture = 11920.9 +/- 2079.23 barn over 200 classified events (Horvitz-Thompson weights of the truncated Rayleigh b); Kramers total at <E_CM> = 0.704281 eV: 8390.29 barn (ratio 1.4208); para:ortho = 2.68688e-05:0.000124914; classical radiative capture (Delta E_dipole > E) at <E_CM>: 4.17329e+07 barn (audit 394)
  forced one-photon capture estimator (audit 550): captured = P = 1 - exp(-Lambda) per event; 1 capture(s) on the photon-free pass (residual continuous exchange, audit 395f) excluded
